title: Mixed Event — Let SEKAI Hear Your Song! — Episode8 All Together Now!

meta.Event Outline: The VIRTUAL SINGERS of each SEKAI see how everyone is progressing toward their goals. They are excitedly preparing ways to demonstrate their support for everyone, when something extraordinary happens.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
Miku and MEIKO sound amazing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I've never heard anyone sing like this...! It's like I'm learning about a completely new style!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and KAITO did a good job with these remixes. They give off such a different impression compared to what we originally had.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
You can tell that he worked on them. They have this fun side to them. It kinda makes me want to start singing...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Woooooow!
You all look way too cute!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, look! Miku's doing my part of the dance!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Len and KAITO are also spectacular.
They both look very cool and bring such a powerful presence to the stage.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I had a feeling they were doing something in secret. I guess this is what they were preparing for.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You know, I almost forgot how much people shine up there...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because we never get many chances to watch these kinds of shows as members of the audience.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I mean, I know that Miku and the others aren't singing our songs and dancing our dances exactly like we did.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I guess this is what our fans see when they watch us perform.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
This is what we've been doing.
We've been spreading hope to all sorts of people!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think that's what Miku and the others are trying to tell us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright!
That means we gotta keep doing more and more and more!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is so cool!
I can't believe they're really playing our songs...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, it's so thoughtful of them...
At the same time, it's a little strange to be hearing someone else play them...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, I'm not sure anyone else has played our songs before.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Miku put on an unbelievable performance during our last show, but Len's just about on par with her.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(I need to keep moving forward...
I think that's the message they're trying to send.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This is nice. It's really soothing...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. Kanade's song was already really good, but this feels so...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I guess this is what she's been focusing on...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I never would've thought she was practicing her singing. That's actually pretty cute of her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. Yeah!
On top of that...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: To think that we'd also get to hear her sing like this.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Still, it's pretty rare of her to want to sing for others like this.

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line:
“Magic is not what creates joy.
Joy is what creates magic.”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “That is why you, Shao, were able to become such a wonderful sorcerer. It's because you were immersed in smiles, laughter and joy for so long.”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “No, not just you. Everyone here. They're all sorcerers in their own right...”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line:
“The lights went out...
The horses and the flying rides...
They've all just stopped...!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line:
“No, I don't want this to happen...!
Master worked so hard to build this place for everybody here...!!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line:
“Wait, no...
This is no time to be crying...”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “This was the last thing Master told me! Everybody here can use magic because you're all smiling, laughing and making this such a happy place...!!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “I can't do this alone! I'm not as good at using magic like Master was, so please, lend me your energy...!!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Lend me your smiles, your joy, your magic...!!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Of course!
We'll give you everything we can!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: H-Hey, you're shouting right in my ear...

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line:
“I'm gonna try, master!
I'm gonna use this energy to make everyone smile...!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow...! Look, you guys...!
Everything's so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She just lit up all of SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This must've taken a monumental amount of time to get set up.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But it was definitely worth the effort...
I'm staggered.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed it is! What a wonderful show!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (The others are probably gonna have to solve a lot of really tough problems in the future...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And they might have a really, really hard time overcoming some of them...!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I wanna keep doing everything I can for them.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I probably wouldn't know what to do if I were all by myself, but with KAITO, Len, Rin, MEIKO, Luka...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (The other Miku that's watching over us. We'll figure out a way! Together!)
